Questions before you order

Custom t-shirt printing FAQs

Should I choose DTF or DTG for my custom shirts?

DTF is versatile across many garment colors and fabric types, while DTG is often a strong choice for detailed artwork on cotton-rich shirts. We can recommend an option after reviewing your design and garment preferences.

What artwork should I provide?

A high-resolution PNG, PDF, SVG, AI, or EPS file is helpful. If your file is different or you are unsure about resolution, send what you have so we can review it.

Can I mix shirt sizes in one order?

Yes. Most group orders include a size range. Share your size breakdown so the quote and garment list can be prepared accurately.

How long will my t-shirt order take?

Timing depends on garment availability, quantity, artwork readiness, and current production capacity. Contact the shop with your deadline before ordering so we can confirm what is realistic.
